scopeChecks.topic: Six concise, three FAQ, and one per fourteen component families
scopeChecks.detail: The independently recomputed all-clean sample contains 6 concise-rule records, 3 base-applicable FAQ units, and 14 sampled-component effects comprising exactly one unit from each expected component family.

The independently selected list has length 23 and set cardinality 23. Manifest class counts, unique audit IDs, the fixed two class quotas, and fourteen disjoint component-family strata prevent overlap; evaluator pass additionally requires sample length 23.
A unit is selectable only when discrepancies are nonempty and every row is classification match with severity none. Empty, presentation-only, mixed, and match/minor controls were all excluded.

Removing all clean units from each of the sixteen strata independently reduced the sample only by that stratum's quota: 17 for missing concise, 20 for missing FAQ, and 22 for each missing component family. No other stratum backfilled the gap, and the final decision failed the 23-unit size gate.

The decision omits deterministicMatchReviewSampleUnitIds while any valid progress row is pending-blind-derivation or blind-derived and publishes it once every row is compared or final. Structural validation separately forbids adjudication until 140 valid, distinct comparison artifacts exist.

Every discrepancy ID in each selected clean comparison must occur in verification review coverage. A selected unit with two match rows and coverage for only one was rejected; covering both restored the clean pass. Structural validation also enforces sourceChecked true, source-packet evidence, independent reviewer identity, substantive response binding, and confirmed disposition for accepted results.
